entities.summary: "Tavo akys" is a song by Lithuanian alternative rock band Katarsis. It was written by Lukas Radzevičius and produced by Jurgis Masilionis. The song was released on 31 January 2025 and represented Lithuania in the Eurovision Song Contest 2025.
